segments.title: August
segments.text: Hello Pop-up! August is Azaadi From Average. Friendship Day, Independence Day and Raksha Bandhan, and a month about freedom: from commitment issues, from price hikes, and from quitting when life gets busy.

segments.title: ₹2.05L
segments.text: So, the number. Our August target for Pop-up is 2.05 lakh rupees. That's 44 per cent above last August. We're growing, and the plan knows exactly how.

segments.title: 3 streams
segments.text: Where does it come from? New clients lead the way with 1.13 lakh rupees. That's 6 of every 10 rupees. Then renewals 90,200, and everything else 2,000. New clients carry this month, so every trial is a first impression worth getting right.

segments.title: 54 buyers
segments.text: Behind the number are people: 631 leads, 164 trials, and 54 buyers, with about 33 per cent of trials converting. Roughly one in five trials becomes a member. Our job is to make it one in four.
Here's where the offers come in. Three offers carry 78,700 rupees, which is 38 per cent of our target. The rest comes from full-price sales, so the offers are a boost, not a crutch. Let's meet them.

segments.title: Squad Goals, Squat Goals
segments.text: First up, for Friendship Day, Squad Goals, Squat Goals. Members book a free Squad Class for up to four friends. Friends who join get fifteen per cent off and friendship-band grip socks. Siblings count, it's Rakhi month. The plan is 2 buyers at about 5,900, so 11,800 rupees.

segments.title: No Strings Attached
segments.text: Next, No Strings Attached. Two classes for nine ninety-nine, credited against a first month, and a break-up clause: if it's not for them after two weeks, what's left turns into a class pack. The plan is 4 buyers at about 5,900, so 23,600 rupees.

segments.title: Freedom to Pause (Not Quit)
segments.text: And finally, for renewals, Freedom to Pause, not quit. Renew for three months and get two Freedom Freezes for Ganpati and Diwali travel, or six months with a private and three freezes. The plan is 6 buyers at about 7,200, so 43,400 rupees.

segments.title: 4 weeks
segments.text: How does the month run? Week one, Friendship Day, and members book free Squad Classes for their friends. Week two, check sell-through every Monday and follow up every trial within a day. Week three, Independence Day and Sibling Barre, and every trial hears about the break-up clause. Week four, every renewal leaves with Freedom Freezes for the festive season.

segments.title: That's the plan
segments.text: That's August at Pop-up. 2.05 lakh rupees, three offers, and 54 buyers to welcome. Freedom looks good on you. So does a longer plan.
